backend/main.mo: Main canister actor implementing access control, user approvals, profiles, and chat request storage with admin caching and authorization checks.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module initializing new stable fields including admin set and chat request storage when upgrading the canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the project.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment runbook detailing build, deploy, verification steps, approval gating checks, rollback, and troubleshooting.
frontend/firestore.rules: Firestore security rules defining access control for user profiles, chat requests, chats, and messages based on role and approval state.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind setup defining extensive CSS variables for light and dark themes plus global base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading Firebase via CDN and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/LIVE_SMOKE_TEST.md: Live smoke test checklist covering signup, approval flow, login behavior, redirects, and console log validation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router managing authenticated and admin routes with React state and screen components.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserRowAct: Admin user action menu with approve, block, and role‑change dialogs.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: Route guard restricting access to admin or super admin users.
frontend/src/components/auth/Authenticat: Route guard ensuring the user is authenticated and profile loaded.
Layout wrapper for auth screens with centered content and footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/SuperAdminR: Route guard restricting access exclusively to super admin users.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Top app header showing logo and profile menu based on user data.
frontend/src/components/layout/ProfileMe: User dropdown menu with profile, admin, and logout actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching a backend actor tied to identity and invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirebaseAuthUser.t: React hook that waits for CDN-loaded Firebase, loads modules, and listens for auth state changes to expose the current user and loading status.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUserProfi: Fetches the authenticated user's Firestore profile using react-query, tied to the auth state from useFirebaseAuthUser.
frontend/src/hooks/useFirestoreUsersList: Provides a react-query list of all users and mutations for updating user approval and roles with automatic invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Defines context and provider for ICP Internet Identity login, loading stored identities, and exposing login state and actions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles plus CSS variables for light/dark themes and global typography settings.
frontend/src/lib/firebase.ts: CDN-based Firebase wrapper providing helpers for auth, Firestore access, and user profile creation and retrieval.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseErrorMessages.t: Maps Firebase error codes to user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/lib/firebaseTypes.ts: Type definitions for user profiles and signup data used across Firebase logic.
frontend/src/lib/postLoginRedirect.ts: Determines post-login route based on user approval and role, sending unapproved users to pending approval.
Utility to resize, compress, and validate user profile images on the client side.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Helper for merging Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminChatsScr: Admin-protected screen showing a placeholder for future chat management features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminDashboar: Admin dashboard displaying user statistics with loading and guarded access.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminLayout.t: Admin layout providing navigation, responsive sidebar, and shared page structure.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminReportsS: Admin screen showing a placeholder for future reports and analytics features.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminSettings: Admin screen with a placeholder for future application settings configuration.
frontend/src/screens/admin/AdminUsersScr: Admin interface listing all users with avatars, roles, approval status, and action controls.
frontend/src/screens/ChatScreen.tsx: Chat interface that loads user chats and messages via React Query, displays conversations, and sends new messages.
frontend/src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx: Home dashboard showing a welcome message and basic cards for getting started and profile management.
frontend/src/screens/LoginScreen.tsx: Login form handling email/password auth, error display, profile fetch, and post-login routing.
frontend/src/screens/PasswordResetScreen: UI-only password reset request screen that records an email and shows an admin-handled reset notice.
frontend/src/screens/PendingApprovalScre: Displays user account pending-approval status with next steps and option to return to login.
frontend/src/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx: Profile view that loads and displays user details, avatar, role, and contact information.
frontend/src/screens/SignupScreen.tsx: Signup UI handling user info, profile photo capture/upload, validation, and Firebase signup.
frontend/src/screens/users/ApprovedUsers: Shows approved users, manages sending and responding to chat requests, and displays incoming and sent request statuses.
frontend/src/screens/users/UserManagemen: Admin view listing all users with controls to approve or revoke approval status.
frontend/src/screens/UsersScreen.tsx: Loads the current user's profile and shows the unified approved users list.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage fallback.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing chat‑flow requirements, roles, routing rules, and feature definitions.
